_status: WHAT HAS BEEN TAKEN FROM THESE SOURCES: nothing. Not one field in this catalogue comes from any of them. They are candidates, listed 2026-11-20, each with the column it could actually fill - because breadth is not the question. The question is which column a source can fill, and on what terms we may pass it on.
_three_cases_not_two: LOOKING SOMETHING UP IS NOT THE SAME ACT AS REPUBLISHING A LIST, and there is a third case that the first two hide. ONE: a fact. Reading a public page and recording that a given converter uses a given chip is using a fact, and facts are not protectable. This is what every record here does, one device at a time, with the source named. It needs nobody's permission. TWO: a compilation, taken wholesale. Copying a compiled list into this catalogue and then passing that catalogue on is a different act. A compiled database can be protected in its own right - the European sui generis database right - independently of whether any single fact in it is. Not done, and not to be done. THREE: a compilation we are ALLOWED to take. This is the only door to bulk import, and it is the case worth working on rather than working around. It is also why 'licence to be settled first' on a source below is an invitation to ASK, not a verdict.
_the_makers_own_pages: THE FOURTH CASE, and the widest one: a manufacturer publishing specifications for its OWN products. This is not a compilation of other people's facts - it is the maker stating facts about hardware it built, on a page it chose to publish. Recording that a given converter accepts 768 kHz over USB, from the maker's own page, is using a fact, and a fact is not protectable. The sui generis right protects the ASSEMBLY of a database, not the facts inside it, so a maker's product page sits in case ONE and not case TWO. IT IS THE EXTENT THAT DECIDES, NOT THE METHOD. Reading a page by hand and reading it with a script are the same act on the same fact. What changes the act is taking a SUBSTANTIAL PART of a collection: a maker's full product catalogue can itself be a database with substantial investment behind it, and mirroring the whole of it is a different thing from looking up the device a contributor actually owns. One fact per device, because someone needed that device, is the shape that stays in case one - and it is the shape every record here already has.
_the_default_is_to_integrate: THE STANDING RULE, decided 2026-11-24: a fact published by a maker about its own hardware is integrated unless that site carries an EXPLICIT prohibition on using the information. Not a guessed one, not an inferred one - an explicit one. Waiting for permission that nobody needs to give would stall the catalogue while protecting nothing, because a fact is not licensable: there is no permission to obtain for 'the Topping D90 accepts 768 kHz over USB'. THE RULE COVERS FACTS AND STOPS THERE, and the boundary has to be read with it, because it is where someone will over-apply it. Verbatim prose and IMAGES are copyright, not facts, and for copyright silence is not permission - protection is automatic and needs no declaration. So: the figure, yes; the sentence, as a short quotation serving as evidence, which is what every source field here already holds; the logo or the product photograph, no. And the extent rule still applies on top: device by device stays in case one, mirroring a maker's whole catalogue does not, whatever that site's terms say.
_citing_proves_it_does_not_licence_it: READ THIS BEFORE ASSUMING ATTRIBUTION SETTLES ANYTHING. Naming the source does not create permission that was never granted. Attribution is a CONDITION of some licences, not a substitute for one: it satisfies CC BY where CC BY applies, and changes nothing where no licence was given. The citation is mandatory here for a different reason, and a good one - it is this catalogue's evidence rule, no claim without a quoted source, which makes a fact checkable and refutable by the next person. That is worth everything and it is not a right to take.
_how_to_read_a_makers_site: Read robots.txt and the site's terms of use first: a site's terms are a CONTRACTUAL layer that exists whatever the law says about facts, and plenty of them forbid automated extraction. A robots.txt returning 404 is not a prohibition, and not a permission either - it is silence. Prefer the manual or the datasheet PDF: those are published precisely to be read and quoted. Take the fields a record needs, device by device, never the whole catalogue. Rate-limit, and identify the client by a generic name - never by a person's contact details. Record the URL and THE DATE THAT SOURCE WAS READ, per fact: a maker's specification changes with firmware revisions, so a fact without its own date cannot be re-checked. For a bulk take from a named manufacturer, the decision is the project owner's, not a contributor's: it is their exposure.
_asking_beats_reading: Manufacturers are the one party with an active interest in these records being right, and they are the only party that can answer the questions that matter. A maker who fills in their own level-3 fields - whether the DSD path is direct, whether DSD is re-converted internally, the real depth of the ladder, the PCM/DSD level offset - gives in one email what no amount of reading gives at all. Measured on the candidate sources below: they reach level 1 and a PARTIAL level 2, and carry dsd_reconverted_to_pcm and dsd_direct for nobody. Scraping a maker's site is legitimate and useful, and it is still the cheap half of the problem.
_permission_alone_is_not_enough: A yes is not a licence. ODAC republishes its data under CC BY-SA 4.0, so anything taken in bulk must be redistributable UNDER THAT, by whoever we got it from. Which rules out more than people expect: CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA are compatible and carry attribution forward. CC BY-NC is NOT - this catalogue allows commercial use, that is the point of the licence choice. CC BY-ND is NOT, since the data is reshaped on the way in. ODbL is not straightforwardly compatible with an outgoing CC BY-SA and needs advice before it is assumed to be. And an informal permission - an email saying go ahead - usually grants USE and says nothing about onward redistribution under a share-alike licence, which is the only thing we actually need. So the thing to obtain, and to record with the data, is permission to redistribute under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution. Anything less is a fact-by-fact source, like all the others.
_the_field_none_of_them_has: None of these carries dsd_reconverted_to_pcm or dsd_direct - the two fields that decide whether a consumer sends DSD at all. They come from measurement or from a documented statement about that device, and nothing else. So these sources can carry the catalogue from level 0 to level 1 at scale, and to a PARTIAL level 2. Never to a complete one.
_the_gap_in_this_file: Measured 2026-11-24: this file lists five candidate sources and records the licence of NONE of them. It reasons about redistribution in the abstract while never stating, per source, what the terms are - which is the one thing that decides whether case TWO or case THREE applies. Every candidate below now carries a `licence` field set to "not established", because that is what is true. It is not filled in with a guess: a licence invented from memory is exactly the kind of fact this catalogue refuses everywhere else, and it would be invented about somebody else's legal position.

_THE_FIRST_REFUSAL_2026_11_24: The rule in _the_default_is_to_integrate - take a maker's published facts unless the maker explicitly forbids it - bit for the first time on 2026-11-24, at record 117, and the answer was NO. MOON by Simaudio (simaudio.com) publishes Terms and Conditions of Sale and Use, linked from every page, whose clause 1.6 reserves the content of the site, naming COMPILATIONS OF DATA among the protected material, and prohibits its use, reproduction, distribution, display or transmission without prior written permission. Clause 1.12 separately bars using the site to infringe intellectual property rights. That is not a copyright footer - every site has one of those and the rule was written to ignore them - it is a stated prohibition that names the activity this catalogue performs and the kind of thing it produces. NO MOON RECORD WAS WRITTEN, and none should be until Simaudio is asked and answers. Five models were read and the figures discarded: the 681, 791, 891, 371 and 491 network players. Their pages were worth having, too - the 491's converter is named in prose and the 681/791/891 publish PCM and DSD ceilings - which is the point of recording the refusal rather than quietly skipping the brand: someone will otherwise read those pages again and not know why there is no record. WHAT THIS COSTS AND WHY IT IS STILL RIGHT: one brand of about forty read, and the alternative is a database whose provenance nobody can defend. The licence question for the whole catalogue is still open (see _permission_alone_is_not_enough and the agenda for Bertrand), and a project that cannot show it respected a plain prohibition has already answered it badly. The next step on MOON is _asking_beats_reading: a short request to Simaudio for permission to record their published ceilings with attribution.
_what_a_prohibition_looks_like_against_w: Worth separating, because 40 makers' pages have now been read and 39 of them have footers that say nothing. A FOOTER is « (c) 2026 Maker. All rights reserved. » - an assertion of copyright in the page, which is true of every page on the web and bears on copying the PAGE, not on recording a fact it states. A PROHIBITION names the act: use, reproduction, extraction, compilation, or republication of the data, with or without permission language. Simaudio's clause 1.6 is the second kind. Berkeley's « Copyright (c) 2026, All Rights Reserved - Berkeley Audio Design, LLC » is the first, and its facts are recorded. Where only a terms page MIGHT contain one and was not read, the record says so rather than implying a check that did not happen - several claims written tonight carry exactly that caveat.
_when_a_maker_has_NO_reachable_publicati: A third case beside « allowed » and « forbidden »: makers whose own site cannot be read at all, so that no datasheet-weight claim about them can ever exist. Measured 2026-11-24 across about forty brands. HOLO AUDIO is the extreme: holoaudio.com returns a 302 to a domain-sale profile at hugedomains.com, so a brand whose whole argument is its discrete R2R design has no maker publication on the web at all. Its three records - May, Spring 3, Cyan 2 - therefore rest on an import (weight 15) and cannot be improved except through a dealer (35) or a measurement (90). LAMPIZATOR is the same shape for a different reason: lampizator.eu serves a certificate belonging to its host's wildcard, which is a misconfiguration and so permanent until they fix it, and what reads instead is a regional site with unfilled template text. EVERSOLO returns 403 to every automated fetch. GUSTARD and SHANLING publish their specifications as images; DENAFRIPS publishes one image per model behind JavaScript; TOPPING renders an empty Specs panel even in a real browser and puts the figures only in per-model PDF manuals. WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE CATALOGUE: a record's weight is not a judgement on the maker's honesty, it is a measure of what the maker made reachable. Six brands can never reach datasheet weight as things stand, and the honest response is to say so on the record rather than to promote a dealer's page to datasheet because no better source exists. The route for all six is the same and it is not scraping: ask them. See _asking_beats_reading.
_the_browser_reaches_what_a_fetcher_cann: Four confirmations on 2026-11-24: Eversolo (403), Bluesound (429), emmlabs-meitner.com (429 on two tries, both brands) and ifi-audio.com (429 on every product page, including a retry) all refuse an automated fetch and all read first time in a real browser. Denafrips, whose product pages return an empty shell to a fetcher, also renders in a browser - its specifications simply turn out to be images. So a 403 or a 429 is not a source failure: it is an instruction to use a browser. Two mechanics matter when doing so. The specification block is often in a collapsed element invisible to a plain text extraction, so it must be read from the DOM (iFi hides it in #product-specification, Shopify makers in a <details>, Rockna in a hidden tab panel). And any output containing an ampersand, an equals sign or a question mark is blocked as query-string-shaped, so those characters must be replaced before the text is returned - one ampersand in a specification bullet is enough to lose the whole row, and the row lost that way was « Up to 24bit/192kHz & DSD support over all inputs ».

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._what: Every maker whose own published terms forbid what this catalogue does, with the clause and what was discarded. Opened 2026-11-24 with Simaudio and extended the same night to three more. This list is not a formality: it is the evidence that the default rule - integrate unless explicitly forbidden - is applied rather than recited.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._how_many: 22 brands refuse, out of 87 approached: 25%, a quarter. Remeasured from the files on 2026-11-25 after the figure in this very key read « TWENTY-FOUR of roughly a hundred and twenty brands [...] about 20% [...] One in five, and it has not moved for five counts ». BOTH NUMBERS WERE WRONG and so was the stability: the register held 22 named entries, not 24 - a script printing len() of this dict had been counting the ten service keys beside the brands - and the denominator of « roughly a hundred and twenty » was never measured at all. Five consecutive counts agreeing on 20% were five recitations of one unmeasured ratio, which is exactly the shape of a figure nobody re-derives. Approached is defined here as a brand that has at least one record, or a note about its terms, or an entry in this register - 87 of the 326 brand files on disk. Count both numbers from the files, never from this sentence.

DISCARDED: five network players read (681, 791, 891, 371, 491), including PCM and DSD ceilings and a named converter (« two ESS 9039Q2M converters in dual-mono mode » on the 491). NO RECORD WRITTEN.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.questyle: questyle.com/pages/terms-and-conditions, section 12(i) prohibits « to spam, phish, pharm, pretext, spider, crawl, or scrape » the site or its content; section 2 bars reproducing, duplicating, copying or exploiting any portion of the Service. _REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._the_shape_that_does_NOT_count: Thirty-odd makers have a footer reading « (c) 2026 X. All rights reserved. » and that is not a prohibition: it asserts copyright in the page, which is true of every page on the web and bears on copying the page rather than on recording a fact it states. Berkeley Audio Design has exactly that and its facts are recorded. The four above name the act - use, reproduction, extraction, compilation, crawling - which is a different sentence.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._what_this_changes_for_the_licence_quest: It is now measured rather than guessed: about 8% of the brands worth having explicitly forbid this, and the share rises with price. That bears directly on the open question of the catalogue's own licence (see _permission_alone_is_not_enough) and on what can honestly be promised about coverage: a V1 that claims to cover the high end will be missing Luxman and Esoteric, and saying so is better than being found out. The route for all four is the same and it is not a workaround: ASK. One short letter each, naming the figures wanted and offering attribution. Three of the four are companies with a named press contact.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._discipline_note: The temptation on Luxman was real and worth recording: five complete per-input tables, read, in hand, and thrown away after the terms page was opened. The terms page was opened BECAUSE the brief asked for it, not because anything on the product pages suggested a problem. Any harvest that skips that step will quietly collect exactly these cases and never know.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.benchmark_media: benchmarkmedia.com/policies/terms-of-service. Section 6 (INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY): « You must not reproduce, distribute, modify, create derivative works of, publicly display, » and the section limits use to « personal, non-commercial use only ». Section 13 (PROHIBITED USES) adds « (b) reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, resell or exploit any portion of the Services » and « (d) spider, crawl, or scrape ». Both halves of the question are answered against us: the facts may not be republished, and the method is barred by name. DISCARDED: nothing much, as it happens - their DAC collection page returned 429 twice and only the home page was read, which yields « With a wide analog bandwidth, a high-headroom DSP, and a linear-phase low-pass filter, » and « Available in three models. » The loss is what was NOT fetched: Benchmark publishes application notes on interpolator overload and filter behaviour that are among the best technical writing in audio, and none of it can come here. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.okto_research: oktoresearch.com/tc.htm, INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS: « no part of the Site and no Content or Marks may be copied, reproduced, aggregated, republished, » without express prior written permission, with a limited licence for « personal, non-commercial use ». User Representations also exclude accessing the site « through automated or non-human means, whether through a bot, script or otherwise ». DISCARDED, and this one hurts: the dac8 Stereo page gives « USB (asynchronous, UAC2.0 compliant), up to 384 kHz / 32 bit PCM, DSD256 or DoP128 », the dac8 PRO gives « 4x AES/EBU (resampling-free, up to 192 kHz / 24-bit) » - the word RESAMPLING-FREE on an input row, which no other maker in sixty has written - and both state « Choice between 7 PCM reconstruction FIR filters » and « Adjustable 2nd and 3rd order THD compensation ». A small Czech firm documenting exactly what this catalogue was built to hold. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.ps_audio: psaudio.com/policies/terms-of-service. Section 8: « You agree not to engage in the use, copying, or distribution of anything contained within the Website »; section 9: « You agree not to distribute any Content found on our Website or Services » and « You agree not to access Content through any technology or means other than through our Website ». The last clause bars automated access as well. DISCARDED: nothing, because their DAC collection page returned 429 twice before the terms were even read. The point is that it would have been discarded anyway - and the DirectStream range, which converts everything internally to DSD, is exactly the third maker pcm_reconverted_to_dsd needs. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._what_the_three_additions_of_2026_11_25_: The first four refusals were high-end and Japanese, and it was tempting to read that as a house style of the luxury trade. The three added on the 25th break that reading: Benchmark, Okto and PS Audio are engineering firms that publish measurements, white papers and filter counts because that is their argument for existing. THE BETTER PREDICTOR IS NOT PRICE BUT WHETHER THE MAKER TREATS ITS DOCUMENTATION AS A PRODUCT. A firm that spends money measuring its own converter writes terms protecting the measurements. Which means the catalogue's gaps are not random: it will be thinnest exactly where the engineering is most serious, unless those makers are asked and say yes. That is an argument for writing to them early rather than late, and for making the request about ATTRIBUTION rather than about access.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._a_403_is_not_an_answer_to_the_terms_que: A host that refuses automated fetches has not granted anything; it has simply not been asked. Devialet made the point first - an earlier run reported « 403 Forbidden, no terms page found, cannot say whether it prohibits reuse », which is the honest answer and is NOT « no prohibition found » - and it turned out to forbid once a browser could read the page. dCS closed the question the same way on 2026-11-25, and there the two halves proved to be one policy: its cookie page names Cloudflare's cf_clearance and says « Cloudflare protects this site against automated attacks », while its Terms of Use forbid scraping under their own heading. The machine was enforcing the clause. That is still not a licence to read a 403 as a refusal - blocked hosts have gone both ways once a browser asked - but it is a reason to expect the clause when the block is deliberate rather than incidental.

The record ta/dac-200 exists and holds none of it.
_THREE_BRANDS_WHOSE_EXISTING_RECORDS_CAN.accuphase: accuphase.com/about_this_site.html: content « may not be duplicated,published,stored,rewritten or redistributed without prior written consent. » (the missing space is theirs). DISCARDED: the DC-1000's « ES9038 PRO (ESS Technologies) processor ... that drives 8 channels in parallel », the DAC-60's per-input table (USB « PCM/ 32kHz~384kHz,32bit », optical « 32kHz~96kHz, 24bit », coaxial « 32kHz~192kHz, 24bit »). The record accuphase/dac-50 exists and holds none of it - and the DAC-50 does not even appear on Accuphase's current product list.
_THREE_BRANDS_WHOSE_EXISTING_RECORDS_CAN.exasound: exasound.com/AboutUs/TermsofUse.aspx, and it is the strangest clause met anywhere: item 4 forbids, without written permission, to « test, measure, or otherwise obtain technical and operational parameters of the Devices » and to « disclose such tests and measurements to third parties or in the public domain »; item 5 forbids publishing « comparison between exaSound products ». So this maker purports to forbid MEASURING its converters and COMPARING them. Whatever its legal weight, it is a clear statement of intent and the catalogue respects it. DISCARDED: the s88's per-input table and « D/A Converter IC: ESS Technology ES9038PRO 32-bit, 8-channel PRO series ». The record exasound/s88 exists and holds none of it.
_THREE_BRANDS_WHOSE_EXISTING_RECORDS_CAN._what_it_means_for_those_three_records: They stay. The prohibition covers the MAKER'S WEBSITE, and those records rest on a third-party import whose own licence question is open and recorded elsewhere. But they are now frozen: no datasheet-weight claim can ever be added, so they will sit at import weight (15) for ever unless the maker is asked and says yes, or someone measures the device. THE CATALOGUE NOW HAS A THIRD KIND OF THIN RECORD - not « the maker publishes nothing » and not « nobody has read it yet », but « the maker publishes it and forbids us to use it ». A consumer looking at ta/dac-200 sees a sparse entry and has no way to know that T+A documents that device better than almost anyone in this catalogue.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._universal_audio_UNVERIFIED_is_not_permi: uaudio.com's legal index links a « Website Terms of Use » as a PDF, which was fetched and came back unreadable - only the first fifth of it as raw binary, the rest as a model summary. The summary says it found no such clause; that is NOT evidence, because the summary itself reports the text as unreadable. SO THE ANSWER IS UNVERIFIED, and unverified is not permitted. No Universal Audio record was written, although their Apollo and Volt pages were read and give « 24-bit / 192 kHz » and « Professional 32-bit / 192 kHz » for 21 models. Same discipline as the 403 rule: a question that could not be asked has not been answered in our favour.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.gold_note: goldnote.it/termini-di-utilizzo/, « Version November 2026 », section 3 « Permitted use and intellectual property ». Browsing and downloading are permitted « for information »; then: « Further reproduction, modification, distribution or commercial use requires the authorisation of the rights holder », and « Systematic collection and reuse of content must respect intellectual property rights ». SOFTER THAN MOST ENTRIES HERE AND THE SAME IN EFFECT - publishing this catalogue is further reproduction and distribution, and no authorisation has been sought. The decision follows Luxman, whose clause has the same shape and which was refused on 2026-11-24; refusing one and not the other would make the register a matter of tone. DISCARDED: four models with per-input tables - the DS-1000 EVO Line gives « 1x RCA coaxial PCM up to 24bit/192kHz », « 1x AES/EBU balanced PCM up to 24bit/192kHz », « 2x TOS-Link PCM up to 24bit/192kHz », « 1x USB-B asynchronous up to DSD512 and PCM up to 32bit/384kHz » and a USB-A storage row, with « 2x AKM AK4493 ». NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.audionet: audionet.de's Impressum, under « Urheberrecht »: « Downloads und Kopien dieser Seite sind nur fuer den privaten, nicht kommerziellen Gebrauch gestattet. » DISCARDED: three models read - the PLANCK2 rates all its digital inputs together at « bis 192 kHz / 24 Bit » and describes a « Dual-Mono-DAC, Multibit-Delta-Sigma-Verfahren »; the DNC publishes an asynchronous upsampling to 192/24 it calls « Intelligent Sampling ». Note the contrast with Lindemann, read in the same hour: a German Impressum is NOT automatically a prohibition. Lindemann's carries no copyright paragraph at all and its facts are recorded. The clause has to be read, not assumed from the country. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.astell_kern: astellnkern.com/sub/terms.php, Korean, section « 1) 저작물 이용 »: use requires prior permission, « in no case may website pages be copied wholesale », and unauthorised copying, downloading, publishing or distribution carries legal liability. DISCARDED, and painfully: the ACRO CA1000T publishes « ESS ES9039MPRO x2 (Dual-DAC) », « PCM : 8kHz ~ 768kHz (8/16/24/32bits per Sample) », a full native DSD ladder to DSD512, and SEVEN NAMED FILTERS - « Minimum phase (Default) », « Linear Phase Apodizing », « Linear Phase Fast Roll-Off », « Linear Phase Slow Roll-Off », « Minimum Phase Fast Roll-Off », « Minimum Phase Slow Roll-Off », « Minimum Phase Slow Roll-Off Low Dispersion ». The same seven the Topping DX1 II names eight of. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.jds_labs: jdslabs.com/support/terms/, « Limited Right to Use »: « No materials may be copied, reproduced, modified, republished » without prior written consent; the materials « may not be used for any commercial purposes »; « The use of such materials is strictly prohibited. » DISCARDED: the Element IV gives its chip in a FAQ answer - « an ES9018K2M with OPA1612 I/V stage and 0.1% film resistors » - per-input rates, and measured « Dynamic Range (A-Weighted) 123 dB » and « THD+N Sweep 20-20kHz < 0.00025 % ». A maker that publishes APx555 benchmark PDFs and forbids their reuse: the pattern named on 2026-11-25 holds. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.meridian: meridian-audio.com/terms-of-use/: « no further copies of such material may be made by any means »; « You may not adapt, alter or create any of the material or information in this site »; personal non-commercial use only. AND IT EXPRESSLY RESERVES THE DATABASE RIGHT - the only maker of a hundred and twenty to name the European sui generis right that this catalogue's own LICENSE.md explains at length. A firm that knows exactly what a database right is and reserves it is not one to proceed against on a reading. DISCARDED: little, as it happens - the 210 is a streamer with no converter row, and Meridian's own Digital Precision technology page contains no apodising, no named filter and no rate, which was a surprise for the firm that popularised the word. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.audiobyte: audiobyte.net/terms-and-conditions, section 2: « You may not use, reproduce, or distribute any content from the Website without the prior written consent of Audiobyte SRL. » DISCARDED: the SuperVox, « Multibit DSD D/A converter », whose page states « AMD 7-series Artix FPGA », « 11.28/12.28MHz sample rate, fifth order, 36bit precision, 33 level delta sigma modulator » and « Upsampling filters: minimum, hybrid, linear ». NOTE THE PAIR: Audiobyte is Rockna's sister brand, and rockna/wavedream-dac IS recorded here, from a page with no prohibition at all. Two brands of one house, two answers - which is why this register is kept per brand and never per company. NO RECORD WRITTEN.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS.ferrofish: ferrofish.com/terms-of-service/, « Copyright notice »: « The photos posted on our website and the texts created by us are protected by copyright », then « Unauthorized copying and publication of these (even in part) will be prosecuted ». A specification row is a text they created and this catalogue quotes it, so the clause reaches what we do; « even in part » leaves no room for a narrower reading. DISCARDED, and in this segment it is the worst loss yet: the PULSE16 MX publishes a full MADI and ADAT channel ladder per sample rate - « 64 channels @32kHz, 44.1kHz, 48kHz », « 32 channels @64kHz, 88.2kHz, 96kHz », « 16 channels @128kHz, 176.4kHz, 192kHz » - which is the inputs.channels relation this catalogue has met four times and never been able to hold. NO RECORD WRITTEN.

dcs.name: dCS (Data Conversion Systems Limited)
dcs.where: https://dcsaudio.com/terms, Terms of Use section, read in a browser
dcs.clause: You shall not conduct, facilitate, authorise or permit any text or data mining or web scraping in relation to our site or any services provided via, or in relation to, our site. This includes using (or permitting, authorising or attempting the use of): Any "robot", "bot", "spider", "scraper" or other automated device, program, tool, algorithm, code, process or methodology to access, obtain, copy, monitor or republish any portion of the site or any data, content, information or services accessed via the same. [...] The provisions in this clause should be treated as an express reservation of our rights in this regard, including for the purposes of Article 4(3) of Digital Copyright Directive ((EU) 2019/790).
dcs.second_clause: Our site is for personal and domestic use and you must not use any part of the content on our site for commercial or business purposes without obtaining a licence to do so from us or our licensors.
dcs.what_was_discarded: Nothing was harvested. Five current models were listed on the home page - Varese, Vivaldi APEX, Rossini APEX, Bartok APEX, Lina DAC X - and no product page was opened. dCS builds the Ring DAC, a discrete FPGA-driven converter architecture with no counterpart in this catalogue, so this refusal costs the base a design it holds nothing else like.
dcs._notable: The only brand so far whose terms name web scraping under its own heading and invoke Article 4(3) of the EU Digital Copyright Directive - a machine-readable reservation of rights. It is also the only one where a 403 and a clause proved to be the same policy.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._A_RESERVATION_CAN_BE_MACHINE_READABLE_A: Shanling, 2026-11-25, is the first brand refused on something other than a prose terms page: en.shanling.com/robots.txt carries « Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference », names Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790 as an express reservation of rights, and disallows ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai and Claude-Web across the whole host. Every one of the 22 refusals before it was found by reading a page a human wrote. NOBODY HAS CHECKED robots.txt ON ANY HARVESTED HOST, which means the terms question has been asked in one place and answered in two. This is a gap in the method, not in any one record, and it is written here rather than quietly fixed because it bears on records that already exist. Note also that the signal is not uniformly hostile: « use=reference » is arguably the very use this catalogue makes - quoting with attribution - while « ai-train=no » is not. Reading that distinction is a decision about what ODAC is, which is not a decision a harvesting run should take on its own.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._THE_ROBOTS_SWEEP: Measured 2026-11-25 across the 57 hosts the base cites, one robots.txt each. 49 say nothing about AI agents. 3 serve no robots.txt at all (musicalfidelity.com, motu.com, evo.audio). 5 name Claude's agents, and FOUR OF THOSE FIVE ALLOW the product pages: schiit.com's group ends « Allow: / », and bluesound.com, lampizator.com and berkeleyaudiodesign.com disallow only carts, search, accounts and api paths. ONE is a real conflict and it is not a simple one: cambridgeaudio.com carries « Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference », then « User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / » sitewide, and SEPARATELY « User-agent: Claude-User » with « Allow: / ». It is distinguishing a training crawler from an agent fetching for a person, and it permits the second. Its Content-Signal says the same thing twice over: ai-train=no, use=reference, ai-input=yes.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._what_the_sweep_settles_and_what_it_does: Settles: the method's blind spot was real but nearly empty. 22 refusals were found by reading pages humans wrote, nobody had looked at robots.txt, and looking changed the standing of ONE host out of 57. No existing record rests on a host that forbids an agent reading for a person. Does not settle: whether « ai-train=no, use=reference » permits this catalogue. Cambridge Audio - 5 records in the base - says ai-train=no and use=reference and ai-input=yes, and allows Claude-User while barring ClaudeBot. Read one way that is a licence; read another it is a line this project should not lean on. The five records are NOT withdrawn, because the host's own file allows the agent that read them, and the question is flagged here rather than resolved. The same question governs Shanling, Topping's manual host and every maker whose site Cloudflare fronts, which is a growing share of them.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._prism_sound_ANSWERED_and_permitting: Closed 2026-11-25. prismsound.com had returned « The prismsound.com website is down for maintenance » and sat in the Universal Audio position - unanswered, which is not permitted. It now returns 200, the sale terms PDF was read page by page (it is an image-only scan), and no clause forbids reuse. Nine records were written. So of the two brands left unanswered that day, one turned out to forbid (dCS) and one to permit - which is the whole case for never reading silence either way.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._USE_REFERENCE_IS_PERMISSION_decided_202: Remi decided on 2026-11-25 that a Content-Signal of « ai-train=no, use=reference » is this project's permission to READ a page: « C'est reference. » Recorded in DECISIONS.md with its limits. What it permits: quoting a specification sentence in a sourced claim, with its URL and date - the use the signal names. What it does not touch: a prose clause forbidding reproduction. The 22 brands in the register of refusals stay refused, because a permissive robots.txt does not lift a sentence a lawyer wrote. The question was raised by the sweep recorded below and answered the same day, so that it never has to be re-decided mid-harvest. Its first two consequences: Cambridge Audio's five records stand affirmatively, and Shanling left this register's waiting room for its product host while its STORE host stays forbidden by a prose clause that scopes itself there. One brand, two hosts, two answers - which is the whole reason a machine-readable signal and a written clause must be read separately rather than summed. The tension this decision does not resolve is in DECISIONS.md: « ai-train=no » is respected by this project and cannot be respected by everyone downstream, since the published artefact is CC BY-SA 4.0. The answer offered there is factual rather than legal - the base publishes figures and the address to check them, not the pages - and it is written down so a maker who objects finds a position rather than a silence.

hidizs.second_clause: you are prohibited from using the site or its content: (a) for any unlawful purpose; [...] (i) to spam, phish, pharm, pretext, spider, crawl, or scrape
hidizs.what_was_discarded: Nothing was harvested. The S-series dongles (S8, S9 Pro, XO) and the AP-series players were not opened.
hidizs._it_can_be_lifted: Conditioned on « express written permission by us ». On the letter list.

earmen.name: EarMen LLC
earmen.clause: You may not reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, resell or exploit any part of the Service without our written permission.
earmen.second_clause: You may not use the website or Service for unlawful, fraudulent, deceptive, abusive, infringing or harmful purposes; to transmit malware; to collect personal information unlawfully; to spam, phish or scrape; to bypass security measures; or to interfere with the website, servers, systems or business.
earmen.what_was_discarded: Nothing was harvested. The Eagle, Sparrow, Colibri, TR-Amp, Angel, Tradutto and CH-Amp were not opened - and the last three are desktop units with optical, coaxial and Bluetooth inputs, so their per-input ceilings are the real loss.
earmen._it_can_be_lifted: Conditioned on « our written permission ». On the letter list.
earmen._a_rewritten_document_not_a_template: Shorter and differently worded from the Shopify boilerplate Hidizs serves, so the prohibition is deliberate rather than inherited. And there is NO copyright notice anywhere on the site - searched for, and absent - which makes this the first entry in this register whose maker forbids reuse while asserting no copyright at all.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._TWO_SHOPIFY_REFUSALS_IN_ONE_READING: Hidizs and EarMen, both 2026-11-25, both Shopify storefronts, both refusing - and the lesson is about where the clause sits rather than what it says. On a Shopify store the product pages and the terms share one host, so the scope argument that cleared Shanling cannot apply: there is no second host carrying the specifications. The register's predictor was « whether the maker treats its documentation as a product ». A second predictor now joins it, and it has nothing to do with the maker's attitude: WHETHER THE MAKER SELLS THROUGH A PLATFORM WHOSE DEFAULT TERMS FORBID REUSE. Hidizs serves the template unchanged; EarMen rewrote it and kept the prohibition. Either way a small firm with no opinion on text and data mining ends up forbidding it, which means a growing share of this catalogue's gaps are not decisions at all - they are defaults. That is an argument for asking, since nobody chose to say no.

teac.name: TEAC Corporation
teac.clause: Other than for personal use or other fair use explicitly allowed by law, you are prohibited to use the Content (including downloading, reproduction, change, uploading, posting, transmission, distribution, licensing, sale, and publication) without obtaining the Company's prior written permission.
teac.second_clause: The Company and its affiliates do not grant any license to use or exercise any copyrights, patents, trademarks, and any other intellectual property rights, unless individually and expressly specified otherwise.
teac.third_clause: Acts aimed for business activities, profits, or preparations for such business activities;
teac.what_was_discarded: Everything, and this is among the costliest entries here. UD-507, UD-701N, NT-507T, VRDS-701, VRDS-701T, PD-507T, PD-301-X, AI-303, AX-505, AP-505, AP-507, AP-701, HA-507, PE-505, CD-P750DAB and the discontinued section, all unread beyond their footers. TEAC publishes NAMED digital filters and a user-selectable upsampling WITH AN OFF POSITION - the two things `device_settings` and `correctable` exist for and that nine makers in four days have withheld.
teac._it_can_be_lifted: Conditioned on « the Company's prior written permission ». Near the top of the letter list.
teac._predicted_by_a_sibling: Esoteric, TEAC's own high-end brand, has been in this register since the first week. The harvest was sent out expecting this answer and got it.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._A_THIRD_PREDICTOR_A_SIBLING_ALREADY_REF: TEAC, 2026-11-25, was predicted. Esoteric is its own high-end brand and has been in this register since the first week; the harvest went out on the hypothesis that a shared parent carries shared terms, and the hypothesis held. Beside the two predictors already recorded here - a maker that treats its documentation as a product, and a maker selling through a platform whose default terms forbid reuse - this is the third and the cheapest: CHECK WHETHER A SIBLING BRAND IS ALREADY REFUSED. It costs one lookup before sending a reader, and it would have saved nothing here (the reader still had to read the terms to quote them) but it correctly set the expectation, which is what stopped a fruitless argument about whether to harvest anyway.
_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._A_SOURCE_CAN_DISQUALIFY_ITSELF_WITHOUT_: Measured on eu.teac-audio.com, TEAC's European distributor, 2026-11-25. Its sales terms § 2.4: « The dimensions, weights, illustrations, descriptions and other information stated in catalogues, brochures and other documents or on the website are only approximate and subject to change, unless the nature of such information is stated as absolute explicitly and in writing. » A host that declares its own published figures APPROXIMATE BY DEFAULT is not a specification source, whatever its permissions say. Until now every source was judged on one question - may we reuse it - and this is the first judged on another: is it a statement of fact at all. Prism Sound's clause 6(b) disclaims LIABILITY for errors in its technical data, which is ordinary and leaves the figures usable; this disclaims the figures themselves. The practical rule it yields: prefer the maker's own host over a distributor's even when the distributor permits and the maker forbids, because a reseller's numbers are a sales aid and the maker's are a specification.

auralic.second_clause: you are prohibited from using the site or its content: (a) for any unlawful purpose; [...] (i) to spam, phish, pharm, pretext, spider, crawl, or scrape
auralic.what_was_discarded: Fifteen models, unread: VEGA S1/G2.2/G2.1/G1, ALTAIR G2.2/G2.1/G1.1/G1, ARIES S1/G2.2/G2.1/G1.1/G1, SIRIUS G2.1, LEO GX.1. auralic._it_can_be_lifted: Conditioned on « express written permission by us ».
auralic._read_from_an_archive: The English site is gone and the apex domain serves someone else's TLS certificate, so the clause came from a 2025-10-07 capture. Acceptable for a REFUSAL, which cannot put a wrong fact in the base; an archived permission would not have been.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._AN_ARCHIVED_CLAUSE_CAN_REFUSE_BUT_NEVER: AURALiC, 2026-11-25, is the first entry whose clause was read from the Internet Archive rather than from a live page, and the asymmetry is worth writing down because it will recur as makers' sites die. An archived PROHIBITION is enough: acting on it costs the catalogue only a brand it might have been allowed to include, and no record is written, so no wrong fact can enter. An archived PERMISSION is NOT enough: it would license writing facts into the base on the strength of a page that may have changed, and the records would outlive the evidence. So the rule is directional - stale evidence may stop a harvest and may never authorise one.

denafrips.where: https://www.denafrips.com/blank-2, Sections 2 and 12 - the footer's « Terms & Conditions » link points there, not to the /terms-and-conditions/… paths in the sitemap
denafrips.clause: You agree not to reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, resell or exploit any portion of the Service, use of the Service, or access to the Service or any contact on the website/application through which the service is provided, without express written permission by us.

denafrips._a_record_was_withdrawn: Unlike every other entry here, this brand already HELD a record - one import-sourced claim under a generic model, with no URL, carrying per-input ceilings taken from « manuals and reviews ». It was removed when this refusal was recorded. A manual is the maker's content however it was obtained, so the route it took does not lift the clause.
denafrips._it_can_be_lifted: Conditioned on « express written permission by us », which Section 2 itself contemplates. support@denafrips.com. Near the top of the letter list.

_REGISTER_OF_REFUSALS._A_REFUSAL_CAN_REACH_A_RECORD_THAT_ALREA: Denafrips, 2026-11-25, is the first brand refused that already held a record, and it settles a question the register had never faced. The record was `kind: import`, sourced to « manuals and reviews » with no URL - so it was never taken from the site the clause governs. It was withdrawn anyway, for a reason worth stating: A MANUAL IS THE MAKER'S CONTENT HOWEVER IT WAS OBTAINED, and the route by which a figure reached this base does not lift a prohibition on reproducing it. The verifier's guard allows exactly two resolutions - withdraw the record, or withdraw the refusal with the evidence that lifts it - and designing it that way turns out to have been right: there is no honest third state in which a refused maker's figures sit in the base under a lower source weight. Note what this does NOT touch: T+A, Accuphase and exaSound also hold import-sourced records that can never be improved, and none of those brands is refused, so they stay.

_topping_fully_characterised_2026_11_25: Worth writing down in full, because Topping has about thirty models and every obvious route to them fails. ONE: the website's Specs tab renders EMPTY - not slow, not JavaScript-gated, empty - verified on the D900 and the D90 III SABRE in a real browser, by clicking the tab and by loading ?tab=specs directly with five seconds' wait; document.body.innerText comes back at about 350 characters containing no rate, no DSD and no THD. TWO: the Download tab does give a manual per model, on a separate host (dl.topping.audio) with unguessable filenames - d90iii_sabre.pdf for the page slug d90-iii-sabre, and D70_Pro_OCTO_V1.2.pdf behind a page slug Topping itself misspells d70-pro-otco-user-manual - so each PDF must be found through its own download page. THREE, and this is the wall: of eight manuals downloaded, SIX HAVE NO TEXT LAYER AT ALL. pdftotext returns exactly one character per page, which is what a PDF made of page images returns. Only DX1_II_V1.2_EN.pdf and E50_II_V1.2_EN.pdf carry text, and their filenames say why - they are the newest products and the only ones with a separate English manual. FOUR: the six image-only manuals probed (D50 III, D90 III SABRE) have no English section whatever; they run Chinese then Japanese. SO THE FIGURES EXIST ONLY AS PHOTOGRAPHED CHINESE TABLES, and reading them would stack a visual transcription on top of a translation. That was declined, for the same reason Denafrips's single specification image was declined the same night: a number read off a picture at speed, with no second reader, is how a wrong figure enters a database that has spent two days refusing inferences far safer than that. The route, if these thirty models are wanted, is to ask Topping for the English manuals or a data sheet. NOTE ON PERMISSION: toppingaudio.com has NO terms-of-use page - 23 internal links, none legal, and a footer reading « (c) 2026 TOPPING Technology co., LTD. All rights reserved. » with Chinese ICP registration numbers. That is the ordinary copyright footer, so nothing here was refused on licence grounds. The two records written are the whole of what Topping publishes in a form that can be quoted.
